_comment: Landfall 2026-10-15: Phylath, World Sculptor's TARGETED landfall ('put four +1/+1 counters on
target Plant you control'). One OLD 0/1 Plant (can attack) and two SICK 0/1 Plants (made this
turn); opponent at 4; a Forest in hand. Playing the Forest is lethal T7 only if the four counters
land on the Plant that can attack NOW: the identity fold makes the two sick Plants one class and
the provider orders the swings-now class first (DecisionProvider::LandfallCounterTargetOrder);
the search may branch the other rank (Plan::landfall_target_choice) and must still pick the kill.
Phylath itself is sick, so the counters are the only damage.
